summary: AliasVault is a self-hosted password manager that combines credential storage with an integrated email alias service. It uses end-to-end encryption to secure your sensitive data on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: Users who want to manage their login credentials while simultaneously generating and controlling private email addresses from a single self-hosted dashboard.
watchOut: As an alternative in the crowded password management sector, you will need to evaluate its maturity against established options like Bitwarden or Vaultwarden before trusting it with critical credentials.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, meaning you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
